text_to_image_prompt: Create the requested production spatial reference for an existing fictional Rian Thalys story location. Image 1 locks the connected spatial geometry; later images lock the existing visual appearance. Natural limestone sea cave opening toward a small human coastal harbor at sunset; water channel through center, dry rocky walking ledge at RIGHT foreground, narrow left ledge, rounded vaulted cavern ceiling. Harbor is distant context beyond mouth, not inside cave. Natural terrain sections instead of building construction; no palace architecture. Asset type: FOUR-VIEW ENVIRONMENT CONTACT SHEET, exactly 2 columns by 2 rows, filling one portrait 9:16 canvas with narrow pale gutters. Four DIFFERENT actual camera views of ONE fixed location, not four new layouts: entry establishing view; reverse view from opposite end; left diagonal view; right diagonal view. Keep lighting/time, materials, number/positions of fixed anchors and adjacent openings consistent with the 3D reference. High-end detailed fantasy game rendering as original. All views at plausible camera height, not isometric. NO people. No text, no titles. Preserve exact existing anchors and materials. Unseen surfaces minimally completed, no new story props. Clear legible professional reference; no watermark.
